ChEMBL biotherapeutic biocomponents for GALINPEPIMUT-S in the trial bundle: the four WT1 heteroclitic peptides, identified from the research code SLS-001 in the trial text

ChEMBL biotherapeutic biocomponents for OMBIPEPIMUT-S in the trial bundle, read from the three-letter strings H-Trp-Ala-Pro-Val-Leu-Asp-Phe-Ala-Pro-Pro-Gly-Ala-Ser-Ala-Tyr-Gly-Ser-Leu-OH, H-Cys-Arg-Met-Phe-Pro-Asn-Ala-Pro-Tyr-Leu-OH and H-Cys-Tyr-Thr-Trp-Asn-Gln-Met-Asn-Leu-OH; the helper peptide reproduces the adegrapepimut-s entry and the two killer peptides the elatipepimut-s entry

ChEMBL biotherapeutic sequence for DULAGLUTIDE in the trial bundle, corroborated by NCATS GSRS DULAGLUTIDE (550 residues); methodology step 2d - the GLP-1 analogue portion is reported, cut at the (GGGGS)3 linker that precedes the IgG4 Fc (...LVKGGG | GGGGSGGGGSGGGGS | AESKYGPPCPPCPAPEAAGG...)

NCATS GSRS record ALBIGLUTIDE (5E7U48495E) subunit: two identical tandem copies of the 30-residue GLP-1(7-36) analogue followed by human serum albumin (DAHKSEVAHRFKDLGEENFKA..., identified in-file as bundle UniProt P02768 Albumin); methodology step 2d - the peptide portion is reported, and the two copies are identical so the sequence is given once

NCATS GSRS record EFPEGLENATIDE (3M1V5Z2270) subunit 3: the 39-residue exendin-4 analogue, with the record's structural modifications - SERINAMIDE at Ser39 (C-terminal amide) and a LYSYL-PEG-PROLYL linker at Lys27 (PEG) to the IgG4 Fc subunits 1-2, which are omitted under step 2d

NCATS GSRS record Efsubaglutide Alfa (7MFJ5FK8CF) subunit: a GLP-1 analogue with an exendin-4 C-terminal extension, cut at the GGGGS linker that precedes the Fc (...GAPPPS | GGGGS | ERKSCVECPPCPAPP...); methodology step 2d

NCATS GSRS record ROMIPLOSTIM (GN5XU2DXKV) subunit: an IgG1 Fc domain ending ...KSLSLSPGK followed by GGGGG-IEGPTLRQWLAARA-GGGGGGGG-IEGPTLRQWLAARA; methodology step 2d - the two identical TPO-receptor-binding peptide repeats are reported once, the Fc carrier omitted
